name: 178. Gemini Responses code execution tool (PR #1333) (gemini-code-execution)
description:
PR #1333 (maximhq/bifrost, open) proposed code execution across OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini. OpenAI and Anthropic already carry it on dev - the OpenAI path forwards code_interpreter and translates the sandbox caller (core/providers/openai/types.go), and the Anthropic path models the full server_tool_use / *_code_execution_tool_result fidelity on ResponsesCodeExecutionCall. Only the Gemini half was missing, and this folder pins that half; it is an independent implementation, not PR #1333's diff.

Four separate gaps in core/providers/gemini/responses.go. (a) convertResponsesToolsToGemini handled only function and web_search, so a code_interpreter tool was dropped before the wire and Gemini never ran code at all - everything downstream was dead code. (b) convertGeminiToolsToResponsesTools did not map codeExecution back, so a Gemini-native request lost the tool on the way in. (c) convertGeminiCandidatesToResponsesOutput emitted executableCode as a markdown-fenced text message and codeExecutionResult as a code_interpreter_call carrying a text content block, with no code and no outputs - not the shape OpenAI and Anthropic produce. (d) processGeminiPart had no case for either part, so a streamed code execution reached the client as nothing.

Fix: code_interpreter converts to Gemini's codeExecution tool (dropped alongside a function tool under the same mixed-tool restriction as Google Search, since pre-Gemini-3 models reject the combination outright), round-trips back, and both parts become one structured code_interpreter_call carrying Code and logs Outputs - on the non-streaming path and, via output_item.added/done with an id minted per call, on the stream.

Cases: (1) code_interpreter reaches the wire as codeExecution with no invented functionDeclarations; (2) codeExecution is dropped beside a function tool while the function declaration survives; (3) executed code returns as a structured code_interpreter_call carrying code and logs outputs, with no text content block leaking onto the item; (4) streamed execution emits added/done lifecycle events for the item, every opened item is closed, and added/done agree on item_id; (5) text that resumes after a code execution opens a new message item rather than streaming deltas onto the already-closed first one (processGeminiTextPart only opened an item on the very first text, so the answer after the code was missing from response.completed). (6) a code_interpreter_call replayed as input reaches Gemini as the executableCode and codeExecutionResult parts it came from (the structured call carries no content, so convertResponsesMessagesToGeminiContents dropped it and the next turn lost the code and its result). (7-11) the integrations convert the structured call back: the GenAI route (generateContent, streamGenerateContent and a replay of native code parts) must return or forward executableCode and codeExecutionResult parts, and the Anthropic route with a Gemini model must return the server_tool_use and code_execution_tool_result blocks, streamed and not. All eleven assert HTTP 2xx loudly with the response body in the failure message.
